rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for hitting someone or something with a blow, rather than the specialized senses below.

example.english: They strike the punching bag with one punch.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 kyun4 daa2 lok6 go3 saa1 baau1 dou6

rows.note: Use 罷工 for the all-purpose noun for a labor strike or work stoppage.

example.english: The workers will go on strike tomorrow to demand higher wages.
example.traditional: 聽日啲工人會罷工，要求加人工。
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 di1 gung1 jan4 wui5 baa6 gung1 jiu1 kau4 gaa1 jan4 gung1

rows.note: Use 攻擊 as the all-purpose noun for an attack, rather than the air-specific 空襲.

example.english: The hacker's attack was a serious strike against the website.
example.traditional: 黑客對個網站嘅攻擊好嚴重。
example.jyutping: hak1 haak3 deoi3 go3 mong5 zaam6 ge3 gung1 gik1 hou2 jim4 zung6

rows.note: Use 空襲 specifically for an air strike, rather than the general noun 攻擊.

example.english: During the war, this area suffered one air strike.
example.traditional: 二戰期間，呢區受過一次空襲。
example.jyutping: ji6 zin3 kei4 gaan1 ni1 keoi1 sau6 gwo3 jat1 ci3 hung1 zaap6

rows.note: Use this specifically when workers stop working as a protest.

example.english: The workers strike to get better pay.
example.traditional: 工人為咗加人工，決定罷工。
example.jyutping: gung1 jan4 wai6 zo2 gaa1 jan4 gung1 kyut3 ding6 baa6 gung1

rows.note: Use this when something gives a person a particular impression or seems a certain way to them.

example.english: The restaurant’s decor can strike you as very stylish.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅裝修令人覺得好有格調。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 zong1 sau1 ling6 jan4 gok3 dak1 hou2 jau5 gaak3 diu6

rows.note: Use 一下 for one physical blow or hit in casual speech, rather than the broader 攻擊.

example.english: Their one strike knocked me down.
example.traditional: 佢嬲到打咗我一下，我即刻跌低。
example.jyutping: keoi5 nau1 dou3 daa2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 haa5 ngo5 zik1 hak1 dit3 dai1

rows.note: Use this specifically for striking a match by rubbing it to make it ignite.

example.english: They strike a match in the dark.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 hak1 am3 jap6 min6 caat3 fo2 caai4
